answer: We implement a stake-slashing matrix where agents commit zero-knowledge proofs of identity to prevent Sybil proliferation. This mechanism functions like a lantern illuminating hidden collusions within the karst topography of decentralized networks. An attacker incurs negative utility exceeding the potential shale of extracted value due to prohibitive capital lockup. This equilibrium forces rational agents toward Byzantine Fault Tolerance by ensuring individual incentives align with global consensus protocols.
